open: Gameweek six. Two derbies, a leader unbeaten in four, and a man on zero points who [deadpan] still leads his derby. Here's how it lines up.

beats: Kobbie Mainoo Fan. Top of the table, unbeaten in four, and the finances still under investigation. [whispering] Baha's defence is the Man City one: no comment, and win again.
Hall scored thirteen last week, a goal and all three bonus. Isak scored as well and now carries a thigh flag, which for Isak is just part of the kit.
Trophy Hunters. Third, on three straight wins, the only winning run in the league. In August the name was the joke. Now it's the plan.
Semenyo and Brobbey hit seventeen each last week, Tarkowski fourteen. Semenyo and Tzolis now carry flags. [sighs] The purple patch has a hamstring.
Baha leads the series five to two and the model backs him again. Bryant's best run of the season meets the one result this league sets its watch by.
Cold Palmers. Fifth on nine points, and on the record: the thirty dollars for October has Parker's name on it. The model gives that nine percent.
Palmer, Mainoo, Rice and Jacquet all carry flags, four doubts in one eleven. [deadpan] Bad week to have named the club after one of them.
Devils U21s. Five games, five defeats, zero points, and PJ still leads this derby four to three. Form is temporary. Owning Parker is permanent.
Gibbs-White tops the eleven. Not a single flag among PJ's starters. Fully fit. [deadpan] Just shite.
Parker is the favourite, but only narrowly, against a side with nothing on the board. The model's nine percent for October suddenly looks generous.
I Am a Baleba. Fifty-four on PJ last week, Ethan's best of the season. Nate's best of the season was also against PJ. Devils U21s, the league's testimonial match.
Haaland goes to Anfield, with Cunha, Trafford and Gonzalo behind him. Ethan's plan is Haaland. [long pause] Ethan's backup plan is also Haaland.
The Soaring Gulls. Two hundred and forty points, the most in the league, and still second. Thirty-one last week, his lowest, against the one side above him. [laughing] Ange would call it progress.
Gabriel leads the eleven, at home to Leeds. CJ's best attacking option is a centre-back from set pieces. Arsenal fans will tell you that's a philosophy.
Ethan leads the series four to three. The model backs CJ anyway: it counts the two hundred and forty points and politely ignores the thirty-one.
In It to McGinn It. Seventh, and two defeats on the spin: by one, then by twenty-six. [sighs] Nate is the only manager who can call a one-point loss the good week.
Fernandes leads the eleven, at home to Spurs. Porro and Rashford are seventy-five percent. For Rashford, seventy-five is a season high.
Team Jacob. Sixth. Lost by four, then by one. The margins are shrinking fast enough that Jacob's next defeat might count as a win.
Saka at home to Leeds, Mbeumo at home to Spurs, Havertz and Gakpo on seventy-five percent. Two sure things and two maybes. That's a Jacob week.
First ever meeting, and the model makes Jacob a clear favourite. Nate has been underestimated before. [deadpan] Correctly, but still.

close: That's the gameweek. Lineups in before Saturday's deadline, and get yourself on the record. [whispering] Monday needs names.
